slides.title: Arguing for and against
slides.subtitle: Building a balanced argument
goals: Present both sides of an issue.
Use linkers of addition and contrast.

head: Function
Phrases
rows: There are arguments on both sides.
One advantage is… / Supporters argue that…
On the other hand… / Critics claim that…

items.q: ___, social media connects people. ___, it can be addictive.
options: On the one hand / On the other hand

items.a: On balance, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
Critics claim that remote work isolates employees.
